newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow Vnukovo airport to upgrade fuel facilities.
newsitem.headline: Moscow Vnukovo airport to upgrade fuel facilities.

text.p: Russia's aircraft fuel supplier Toplivno-Zapravochnaya Kompaniya (TZK) will modernise Moscow's Vnukovo airport fuel facilities by the end of this year, the company's chief executive said on Monday.
Sergei Vasilyev told Reuters the project would expand the fuel reserve capacity at the airport over the next few months.
"The airport upgrading enables us to increase the reserve of aircraft fuel to three weeks from two weeks currently," Vasilyev said.
He said that Vnukovo would have four tanks with a capacity of 2,000 tonnes of kerosine each after the upgrade.
"We will also inspect the entire fuel tube system at the airport and build a new 1.5 km (one-mile) fuel pipeline there," he added.
Vasilyev did not say how much the upgrade would cost.
Vnukovo is one of four Moscow airports which operates many domestic and several international passenger and cargo flights.
